response.rationale: These are two different concepts: one is a part and the other is the whole. In PlaceOrderUseCase (node 6860bbf1a3b5131d, src/ordering/application/place-order.use-case.ts), the line `execute(id: string, customerEmail: string, lines: readonly OrderLine[]): Order {` takes a collection of OrderLine items and returns an Order. So an order line is one item inside an order, not the order itself. In OrderNotificationService (node ee110f001f97012a, src/notifications/application/order-notification.service.ts), the line `const subtotal = order.subtotal();` works on the whole Order and its total. Order Line and Order are linked by containment, but they are not one concept under two names.
